answer.book: A single Latin academic dissertation (Zürich, 1695) by Johann Heinrich Heidegger on Apocalypse 14:6-7 and the eternal gospel: a title page with the presiding professor and respondents, then one long text divided into numbered sections, of which only section I appears on the sheet.

entries.title: Dissertatio textualis ad Apocalyps. Cap. XIV.6.7. &c. De evangelio æterno
